text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"This video will self-destruct in thirty
seconds."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? I didn't realize this was a
spy film.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And here I thought I'd seen all of them.
What an
oversight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it must be fun being a spy. Just
once in my
life, I want to drive a car and
launch my seat up
into the air with the
touch of a button.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just how many movies are in this series? I
have to
watch them all before the new
one comes out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan gets so caught up
watching spy
movies, she stays awake
into the early hours.
